clues.it: Rosa era nella 10ª colonna e nelle Segrete.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 10th column and in the Dungeon.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Giada era nella 3ª colonna, accanto a uno sgabello e a nord di Vito, ma non era accanto a una libreria.
clues.en: Giada was in the 3rd column, beside a stool and north of Vito, but was not beside a bookcase.

clues.it: Anna era nella 8ª colonna e accanto a un trono, ma non era accanto a un tappeto.
clues.en: Anna was in the 8th column and beside a throne, but was not beside a rug.

clues.it: Nino era accanto a una botte, a ovest di Olga e in Armeria.
clues.en: Nino was beside an ale barrel, west of Olga and in the Armory.

clues.it: Tea era l'unica persona su delle catene e a ovest di Rosa.
clues.en: Tea was the only person on loose chains and west of Rosa.

clues.it: Olga era nella 4ª colonna e a ovest di Rosa.
clues.en: Olga was in the 4th column and west of Rosa.

clues.it: Vito era nella 1ª colonna, nella 8ª riga e a ovest di Giada.
clues.en: Vito was in the 1st column, in the 8th row and west of Giada.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 5ª colonna e in Biblioteca, ma non era accanto a delle catene.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 5th column and in the Library, but was not beside loose chains.

clues.it: Luca era a ovest di Rosa e in Biblioteca.
clues.en: Luca was west of Rosa and in the Library.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 10th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Giada lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Giada's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 3rd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 8th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Tea lascia una sola casella libera: riga 6ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Tea's own clue leaves a single free square: row 6th, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Vito lascia una sola casella libera: riga 8ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Vito's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio di Sergio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Sergio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 5th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 4ª riga: escludendola, a Nino resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Nino a single square: row 5th, column 2nd.

steps.it: Luca può stare solo nella 6ª colonna.
steps.en: Luca can only be in the 6th column.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «3 persone in Armeria» non torna senza Olga: deve stare in riga 7ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: The general clue “3 people in the Armory” cannot add up without Olga: they must be at row 7th, column 4th.

steps.it: Olga può stare solo nella 7ª riga: escludendola, a Luca resta una sola casella: riga 10ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Olga can only be in the 7th row: ruling it out leaves Luca a single square: row 10th, column 6th.

steps.it: Escludendo la 6ª colonna di Luca, a Irene resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Ruling out Luca's 6th column leaves Irene a single square: row 2nd, column 7th.
